title: Design System: SSU Commerce Market Theme

display.purpose: Shop, product, cart, and checkout arrivals.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes hero, product, category, and content reveals when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Commerce Action
components.description: The tenant-controlled primary action used for shopping, checkout, and valid recovery.
components.css: .ds-market-action { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary-700, #315f6b); border-radius: 0.125rem; background: var(--color-primary-700, #315f6b); color: var(--on-primary, #fff); padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font: 700 0.875rem/1.25 var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-market-action:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-market-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-700, #315f6b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Catalogue Register
components.description: A compact tenant, catalogue, and current-route context band.
components.css: .ds-market-register { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; min-height: 2.625rem; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #aaa99d; background: #f2ede3; color: #5b6258; padding: 0 1.5rem; font: 750 0.6875rem/1.2 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-market-register span:nth-child(2) { border-inline: 1px solid #aaa99d; color: #a33d2e; padding-inline: 1.25rem; } .ds-market-register span:last-child { text-align: right; }

components.name: Catalogue Index
components.description: Tenant destinations shown as a horizontally resilient product index.
components.html: ShopCollectionsGift cards
components.css: .ds-market-index { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid #aaa99d; background: #fffdf8; } .ds-market-index a { display: flex; min-height: 3.25rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; border-right: 1px solid #aaa99d; color: #202820; padding: 0.75rem 1.125rem; font: 700 0.8125rem/1.2 var(--font-body, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-market-index i { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #aaa99d; } .ds-market-index a:hover, .ds-market-index a:focus-visible { background: #edf2ee; } .ds-market-index-active i { border-color: #a33d2e; background: #a33d2e; } .ds-market-index a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-700, #315f6b); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Product Row
components.description: An untinted product plate with a factual left-aligned caption and tabular price.
components.css: .ds-product-row { border-top: 1px solid #aaa99d; background: #fffdf8; color: #202820; padding-top: 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-product-media { display: grid; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; place-items: center; background: #e8e3d9; color: #5b6258; } .ds-product-row h3 { margin: 0.875rem 0 0; font: 700 0.875rem/1.3 var(--font-heading, sans-serif); } .ds-product-row p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: #5b6258; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-product-row strong { display: block; margin-top: 0.5rem; color: #a33d2e; font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Order Field
components.description: A precise order-sheet field with tenant-controlled focus and caret.
components.css: .ds-order-field { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid #aaa99d; border-radius: 0.125rem; background: #fffdf8; color: #202820; caret-color: var(--color-primary-700, #315f6b); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-order-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-700, #315f6b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-order-field::placeholder { color: #5b6258; opacity: 0.78; }

narrative.overview: Commerce Market is a distinct SSU storefront world for product-led tenants. It turns discovery, comparison, ordering, and payment into one continuous merchant document: real product imagery sits beside factual names, prices, variants, stock states, and actions rather than inside promotional card chrome. The system feels practical, tactile, and exact. Warm paper and ruled order sheets make dense catalogue information approachable; dark merchant ink anchors decisions; a vermilion registration mark identifies position; and the tenant's primary colour remains authoritative for actions and keyboard focus. Product photography stays untinted and transaction rules stay untouched.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stock paper and clean order sheets.
Ruled product rows with square, untinted image wells.
Tabular prices and compact catalogue labels.
Vermilion registration marks paired with semantic active states.
Flat transaction documents without persistent shadows or decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Price Is Factual Rule
rules.body: Price, inventory, tax, discount, shipping, and payment states come from the existing commerce system; the theme never decorates them into a different meaning.

rules.name: The Registration Has Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Vermilion may reinforce the current destination, but route semantics, text, or structure must communicate the same state independently.

rules.name: The Merchant Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve configured heading and body families; the buying-book identity comes from hierarchy, rules, alignment, and numerals rather than a fixed theme font.

rules.name: The Document Before Card Rule
rules.body: Persistent commerce information uses a rule, paper tone, or spacing change instead of a floating card shadow.

dos: Do place real product imagery, name, price, availability, and actions early in the shopping journey.
Do preserve the existing product, variant, favourite, cart, tax, shipping, discount, gift-card, checkout, payment, and tracking contracts.
Do use tenant-provided navigation, merchandising content, media, and appearance tokens.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion, localization, honest empty states, and mobile task parity.
donts: Don't fabricate discounts, urgency, reviews, best-seller status, inventory, delivery promises, product claims, or promotions.
Don't tint product photography or let decorative media delay product discovery.
Don't move API, tenant, cart, checkout, payment, SEO, localization, or module logic into the theme renderer.
Don't use floating soft cards, ornamental gradients, or persistent shadows as the commerce structure.
